title: IBRNet: Learning Multi-View Image-Based Rendering
layout_note: Three columns: a 3-D scene column (source and target photos around a dotted scene cube with one orange ray), a beige middle panel (per-sample MLPs feeding a ray transformer, with a rounded detail callout of one MLP at its bottom), and a right column of volume-rendering plot over the rendering loss, joined by hollow block arrows.
grouping: The learned part sits on one pale beige rounded background panel; a darker beige rounded callout inside it, attached by a wedge to one of the three MLP glyphs, zooms into that MLP. Views are told apart by frame style keyed in a top-left legend: solid green frames for source views, dotted dark-red frame for the target view. Bold titles head the right column steps.
shapes_depth: Source and target views are photo cards tilted in perspective around a dotted wireframe box holding the object render; the target ray is a thick orange arrow from a small camera-eye glyph, with three blue sample dots; dashed lavender and cyan lines project a sample into source views A and B. MLPs are three thin unfilled rectangles; the ray transformer is a large rounded square with faint all-to-all lines inside. Inputs in the callout are hatched striped bars whose stripe colours are keyed in a mini legend (image colour, viewing direction, image feature). The density plot reuses the orange ray as its x-axis with the three blue dots on it; the loss is two colour squares inside norm bars.
proposed_highlight: The learned modules are grouped on the single tinted panel and the new cross-sample module is the largest box there, drawn with faint internal connections; the zoom callout expands one per-sample MLP in place.
lesson: Reuse the scene ray as the density plot's x-axis, with the same coloured sample dots placed on it, so the volume-rendering step visibly comes from the ray drawn in the scene.
notes: venue CVPR from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2102.13090), the same as the CVPR year. Photos of the scene are embedded rasters.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
